result.description:
Your Opportunity
We currently have exciting opportunities for Senior Consultant, Managers, Senior Managers and Directors across our Tax division.

Corporate Tax Advisory/Corporate Tax DDX
Our Corporate Tax division helps businesses understand corporate tax matters and comply with ATO filing obligations. We recognise that multinational businesses face obstacles in managing tax across different jurisdictions and we use our local and global expertise to cut through the complexity this entails. 

M&A Tax/Stamp Duty
The KPMG State Tax Deals and Stamp Duty teams work on the most significant transactions in the Australian Market. They are market leading teams supporting clients with tax due diligence, structuring, modelling, duty and land tax compliance and dispute resolutions. 

GST Advisory/GST DDX/Employment Tax/Payroll/Trade & Customs
Our Indirect Tax division within the KPMG Specialist Tax and Reward business consists of market leading teams that provide high-touch, value-add advisory and compliance services. We support clients across the market through consulting on FBT, payroll tax, superannuation obligations, GST advice and international trade strategy.

GMS Tax Advisory/GMS DDX
Our Global Mobility Services teams are part of the KPMG People Services business in Australia and offers both Australian and international tax services to clients. We work across all areas of Global Mobility and related tax matters providing a high-touch, value-add advisory and compliance services to our clients.

Performance & Reward
KPMG’s Performance & Reward team is our leading remuneration practice advising ASX200 and unlisted company Boards and C-Site on remuneration and reward issues. We help our clients implement remuneration plans to reward and retain their people.

Migration DDX
Our national immigration practice is a team of registered migration agents and administrators that manage the visa requirements involved in the relocation of individuals and their families from one country to another by working closely with taxation specialists and global mobility professionals. 

Transfer Pricing 
Our Transfer Pricing Services practice is an international team of economists, tax practitioners and analysts helping clients generate tax efficiencies and reduce the risk of challenges from revenue authorities. Our multi-disciplinary approach and global mindset enable us to cover issues such as developing and executing commercially viable transfer pricing policies, compiling documentation for revenue authority audits and complying with local revenue requirements.

Tax Governance & Transparency
The Tax Governance & Transparency team advises organisations nationally and internationally on better practices in respect of tax governance and sustainability through tax transparency and risk management disciplines. 

Tax Reimagined
Our Tax Transformation team assist clients in transforming their tax functions to increase efficiency, improve governance and accuracy of their tax reporting. 

Tax Controversy
Our Tax Controversy team complements KPMG's traditional service offerings by providing high-quality legal services to our clients. The team prepare for, manage and resolve tax disputes, whilst maintaining an effective working relationship with revenue authorities.

How are you extraordinary?
•	You enjoy working in the details, with a proactive attitude towards accuracy and deadlines
•	You actively seek out opportunities for growth, are comfortable challenging the status quo, and enjoy getting out of your comfort zone

Your Experience
To be considered for this opportunity, your qualifications, skills & experience could include:

Corporate Tax Advisory/Corporate Tax DDX
•	Advisory and compliance experience
•	High level of commitment to quality client service
•	Preferably CA/CPA qualified or with a Master’s of Taxation.

M&A Tax/Stamp Duty
•	Demonstrated experience as a Finance/Accounting/Law professional, ideally with significant recent experience in duty in an M&A/ transactional tax environment
•	You are passionate about the importance of fantastic communication to share ideas, inspire and create change. You are able to digest, distil, and communicate complex concepts in both written and verbal forms.

GST Advisory/GST DDX/Employment Tax/Payroll/Trade & Customs
•	A degree in Accounting, Commerce or other relevant disciplines
•	You enjoy working in the details, with a proactive attitude towards accuracy and deadlines
•	You are analytically minded and enjoy applying structured thinking and analysis techniques to complex problems.,

GMS Tax Advisory/GMS DDX
•	Experience with expatriate tax compliance issues, with strong Tax compliance knowledge, including preparation and/or review of company and trust income tax returns, distribution reviews and tax provisions

Performance & Reward
•	A broad mix of technical knowledge suited to working in the Leadership, Performance and Reward space
•	Sector experience within consulting, a large listed corporate, or government
•	You like to be proud of the work you produce and are accountable and committed to owning high-profile projects.

Migration DDX
•	Must be a Registered Migration Agent with sound understanding of migration legislation in a high-volume environment
•	You are committed to providing fantastic customer service, with kindness and empathy at the heart of every interaction.

Transfer Pricing 
•	Prior transfer pricing experience in a Big 4 or mid-tier firm, the ATO or corporate environment
•	A degree in Accounting, Economics, Commerce, Finance or Law, and/or undertaking/completion of the CA/CPA

Tax Governance & Transparency
•	Tertiary qualifications in a related discipline such as Business, Tax, Law, Audit or Finance / Commerce
•	You enjoy working in the details, with a proactive attitude towards accuracy and deadlines.

Tax Reimagined
•	A tertiary qualification (preferably Finance/Accounting and/or Maths/ Computer Science related) will be viewed favourably, with previous Indirect Tax Technology implementation experience
•	Expertise in defining and/or configuring tax logic and content within third-party tax solutions (ONESOURCE, Vertex or equivalent)
•	ERP Technology implementation experience (preferably SAP, Oracle, Workday or NetSuite) – ideally in Tax
•	You actively seek out opportunities for growth, are comfortable challenging the status quo, and enjoy getting out of your comfort zone.

Tax Controversy
•	Previous experience in corporate tax, international tax, tax law and/or tax dispute resolution and controversy in either a Big 4 professional services firm, a law firm or the Australian Taxation Office.
•	Ability to quickly establish a high level of stakeholder engagement, and able to hold the role of an advisor to the business and be an expert on a topical area(s) of tax law
•	Ability to integrate information from a variety of different sources, consider the broader impact of issues and how it will affect the project, engagement and the business

result.description: InvestorKit  The Business Innovation Analyst plays a pivotal role at InvestorKit, sitting at the intersection of our Strategy and Technology divisions. You will work closely with the Portfolio Strategists to understand how clients are being served, identify friction points in the strategy journey, and translate those insights into precise technical requirements and software solutions that help the team scale with quality.  You will be responsible for ensuring the tools, systems, and processes that underpin the Strategy division are fit for purpose — championing software quality through rigorous testing, documenting how we work, and enabling our Strategists to spend more time delivering exceptional client outcomes and less time navigating process gaps.  From day one, you will have a tangible impact on revenue and client outcomes, working alongside a talented, mission-driven team that will invest in your growth both personally and professionally       Benefits   Opportunity to work on ICT projects and business process improvement initiatives.  Exposure to CRM systems, data analytics, and cross-functional collaboration.  Ongoing learning and professional development opportunities.  Involvement in Data & AI initiatives and innovative technology solutions.  Collaborative environment with opportunities to work closely with senior leadership and key business stakeholders.  Opportunity to contribute to a growing, technology-driven organisation.    Task & responsibilities  The responsibilities outlined below represent the core expectations of the role. As a team member at InvestorKit, you are also expected to actively uphold our values, contribute to our mission, and make decisions that support our vision of becoming Australia’s leading buyers agency.   Collaborate with Business Stakeholders    Schedule and lead regular meetings with business stakeholders — including the Portfolio Strategists, and senior leadership — to review project progress and address concerns.  Facilitate workshops with the Strategy division to map current workflows, identify inefficiencies, and gather detailed requirements for improvement.  Serve as the primary liaison between the Strategy team and development resources, ensuring technical solutions reflect real operational needs.  Provide technical insights and recommendations to stakeholders to help shape project objectives.  Document meeting outcomes and follow up on action items to ensure alignment and progress.  Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across Strategy, Operations, Acquisitions, and Research to foster cross-divisional collaboration.    Project Management    Create detailed project timelines and milestones to track progress and ensure timely delivery.  Use project management software to monitor tasks, deadlines, and resource allocation.  Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to address project challenges proactively.  Conduct regular project status meetings with team members and stakeholders to keep everyone informed.  Prepare and distribute project status reports, highlighting key achievements, upcoming tasks, and issues.    Support the Strategy Division    Support the build and continuous improvement of CRM workflows, portfolio tracking tools, and client milestone systems used daily by the Strategy team.  Participate in Strategy team meetings and Data & AI huddles to stay close to operational priorities and emerging needs.  Analyse data from CRM and portfolio systems to surface trends, gaps, and opportunities that inform strategic decision-making.  Contribute to the development of frameworks, scripts, and tools that help Strategists deliver more consistent, high-quality client outcomes at scale.    Gather and Document Business Requirements    Organise and conduct requirement-gathering sessions with stakeholders and subject matter experts.  Use various techniques such as interviews, surveys, and workshops to elicit business requirements.  Create detailed requirement specification documents and obtain approval from stakeholders.  Maintain a requirements traceability matrix to ensure all requirements are addressed throughout the project lifecycle.  Collaborate with technical teams to ensure a clear understanding of requirements and provide clarifications as needed.    Conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT)    Design and execute comprehensive UAT plans, including test cases, scenarios, and acceptance criteria.  Coordinate with end-users to schedule and conduct UAT sessions.  Collect and document user feedback during UAT, categorising issues by priority and severity.  Work with development teams to address defects or issues identified during UAT.  Ensure thorough documentation of UAT results and obtain formal sign-off from business stakeholders.    Development of Training Materials and User Documentation    Collaborate with subject matter experts to gather information for training materials.  Create step-by-step guides, FAQs, and user manuals to support new software solutions.  Develop and deliver virtual training sessions to ensure effective user adoption.  Continuously update documentation based on user feedback and software updates.  Provide ongoing support to users, addressing questions or issues related to new software.    Additional Responsibilities    Actively participate in all team meetings, 1:1s, and Data & AI huddles.   Drive your own continuous learning and development, both personally and professionally.  Adapt as the role evolves with the company’s growth, always aligned with our mission.  Complete other activities as required by management and the senior leadership team     Qualification & experience   Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field. About Codafication
Codafication is a tech company located just off James Street in Brisbane’s Fortitude Valley. We have developed globally recognised solutions for the insurance and construction industries.  Our mission is to pioneer new ways to make the world simpler - and we are building solutions that streamline experiences for our customers making them more efficient and cost-effective. With deep domain knowledge and client partnerships across the trillion-dollar global insurance and construction industries, we are scaling our products and utilisation across Australia, New Zealand and into North America. 
Check us out at Codafication.com 
About the Role
No day is the same as a Customer Success Officer at Codafication! To succeed in this role you will be flexible in your daily activities, enjoy problem-solving and looking for new ways to help customers achieve success using Codafication’s tools. 

As the voice of our customers, you will play an important role in our business working closely with the Project Management, Business Analyst and Software Engineering teams to manage different projects to success. You will provide clear and empathetic customer service and technical support ensuring clients experience success with Codafication’s product offerings.

Your day-to-day duties will include: 

•	Delivering onboarding, training, coaching, and mentoring for customers
•	Building and maintaining strong business relationships with customers
•	Providing frontline support to customers and management of Jira support tickets
•	Building and maintaining high quality customer-facing materials and repositories (e.g. knowledge base library, FAQs, training packages)
•	Providing feedback, support, and updates to internal stakeholders to optimise the customer experience
•	Conducting workshops, demonstrations, training, and reviews of products with customers
•	Driving adoption and retention, while identifying opportunities for account growth and additional product placement


About you
As our successful candidate, you will demonstrate;
•	At least 3 years of relevant work experience
•	Technical experience would be advantageous
•	Excellent written and verbal skills 
•	Love for problem solving and thrive in a dynamic and fast paced environment
•	Ability to win trust and drive relationships to ensure best outcomes for customers and the business
•	Excellent resource management and planning skills
•	Highly motivated with a desire to learn and grow
•	Ability to resolve customer complaints, enquiries, and conduct basic troubleshooting quickly and efficiently

Life at Coda
•	Brand new Fortitude Valley Office bordering James Street Precinct
•	Quarterly staff functions - Celebrate our success as a team
•	Be recognised and rewarded for your achievements
•	Revitalise Days + Volunteer Leave giving you up to 4 extra leave days a year to do what you love
•	Regular 1-2-1 time with your leader to accelerate your career
•	Genuine career progression
•	Hybrid working environment to promote genuine work-life balance

If you want to be part of a winning team and this role suits you to a tee, I would love to hear from you. We do have an immediate start available however happy to wait for the right person given notice periods. 

Salary offered is $75k to $85k

Your Opportunity
We currently have exciting opportunities for Senior Consultant, Managers, Senior Managers and Directors across our Tax division.

Corporate Tax Advisory/Corporate Tax DDX
Our Corporate Tax division helps businesses understand corporate tax matters and comply with ATO filing obligations. We recognise that multinational businesses face obstacles in managing tax across different jurisdictions and we use our local and global expertise to cut through the complexity this entails. 

M&A Tax/Stamp Duty
The KPMG State Tax Deals and Stamp Duty teams work on the most significant transactions in the Australian Market. They are market leading teams supporting clients with tax due diligence, structuring, modelling, duty and land tax compliance and dispute resolutions. 

GST Advisory/GST DDX/Employment Tax/Payroll/Trade & Customs
Our Indirect Tax division within the KPMG Specialist Tax and Reward business consists of market leading teams that provide high-touch, value-add advisory and compliance services. We support clients across the market through consulting on FBT, payroll tax, superannuation obligations, GST advice and international trade strategy.

GMS Tax Advisory/GMS DDX
Our Global Mobility Services teams are part of the KPMG People Services business in Australia and offers both Australian and international tax services to clients. We work across all areas of Global Mobility and related tax matters providing a high-touch, value-add advisory and compliance services to our clients.

Performance & Reward
KPMG’s Performance & Reward team is our leading remuneration practice advising ASX200 and unlisted company Boards and C-Site on remuneration and reward issues. We help our clients implement remuneration plans to reward and retain their people.

Migration DDX
Our national immigration practice is a team of registered migration agents and administrators that manage the visa requirements involved in the relocation of individuals and their families from one country to another by working closely with taxation specialists and global mobility professionals. 

Transfer Pricing 
Our Transfer Pricing Services practice is an international team of economists, tax practitioners and analysts helping clients generate tax efficiencies and reduce the risk of challenges from revenue authorities. Our multi-disciplinary approach and global mindset enable us to cover issues such as developing and executing commercially viable transfer pricing policies, compiling documentation for revenue authority audits and complying with local revenue requirements.

Tax Governance & Transparency
The Tax Governance & Transparency team advises organisations nationally and internationally on better practices in respect of tax governance and sustainability through tax transparency and risk management disciplines. 

Tax Reimagined
Our Tax Transformation team assist clients in transforming their tax functions to increase efficiency, improve governance and accuracy of their tax reporting. 

Tax Controversy
Our Tax Controversy team complements KPMG's traditional service offerings by providing high-quality legal services to our clients. The team prepare for, manage and resolve tax disputes, whilst maintaining an effective working relationship with revenue authorities.

How are you extraordinary?
•	You enjoy working in the details, with a proactive attitude towards accuracy and deadlines
•	You actively seek out opportunities for growth, are comfortable challenging the status quo, and enjoy getting out of your comfort zone

Your Experience
To be considered for this opportunity, your qualifications, skills & experience could include:

Corporate Tax Advisory/Corporate Tax DDX
•	Advisory and compliance experience
•	High level of commitment to quality client service
•	Preferably CA/CPA qualified or with a Master’s of Taxation.

M&A Tax/Stamp Duty
•	Demonstrated experience as a Finance/Accounting/Law professional, ideally with significant recent experience in duty in an M&A/ transactional tax environment
•	You are passionate about the importance of fantastic communication to share ideas, inspire and create change. You are able to digest, distil, and communicate complex concepts in both written and verbal forms.

GST Advisory/GST DDX/Employment Tax/Payroll/Trade & Customs
•	A degree in Accounting, Commerce or other relevant disciplines
•	You enjoy working in the details, with a proactive attitude towards accuracy and deadlines
•	You are analytically minded and enjoy applying structured thinking and analysis techniques to complex problems.,

GMS Tax Advisory/GMS DDX
•	Experience with expatriate tax compliance issues, with strong Tax compliance knowledge, including preparation and/or review of company and trust income tax returns, distribution reviews and tax provisions

Performance & Reward
•	A broad mix of technical knowledge suited to working in the Leadership, Performance and Reward space
•	Sector experience within consulting, a large listed corporate, or government
•	You like to be proud of the work you produce and are accountable and committed to owning high-profile projects.

Migration DDX
•	Must be a Registered Migration Agent with sound understanding of migration legislation in a high-volume environment
•	You are committed to providing fantastic customer service, with kindness and empathy at the heart of every interaction.

Transfer Pricing 
•	Prior transfer pricing experience in a Big 4 or mid-tier firm, the ATO or corporate environment
•	A degree in Accounting, Economics, Commerce, Finance or Law, and/or undertaking/completion of the CA/CPA

Tax Governance & Transparency
•	Tertiary qualifications in a related discipline such as Business, Tax, Law, Audit or Finance / Commerce
•	You enjoy working in the details, with a proactive attitude towards accuracy and deadlines.

Tax Reimagined
•	A tertiary qualification (preferably Finance/Accounting and/or Maths/ Computer Science related) will be viewed favourably, with previous Indirect Tax Technology implementation experience
•	Expertise in defining and/or configuring tax logic and content within third-party tax solutions (ONESOURCE, Vertex or equivalent)
•	ERP Technology implementation experience (preferably SAP, Oracle, Workday or NetSuite) – ideally in Tax
•	You actively seek out opportunities for growth, are comfortable challenging the status quo, and enjoy getting out of your comfort zone.

Tax Controversy
•	Previous experience in corporate tax, international tax, tax law and/or tax dispute resolution and controversy in either a Big 4 professional services firm, a law firm or the Australian Taxation Office.
•	Ability to quickly establish a high level of stakeholder engagement, and able to hold the role of an advisor to the business and be an expert on a topical area(s) of tax law
•	Ability to integrate information from a variety of different sources, consider the broader impact of issues and how it will affect the project, engagement and the business

Job description

Fetch Recruitment is an Australian owned recruitment consultancy, delivering long term benefits to both our candidates and clients within the built environment. At Fetch, we passionate about empowering people to take charge of their careers and realize their potential, regardless of whether this is the candidates we partner with or colleagues in our team. We are looking for a highly driven and polished Business Development Manager committed to building a lasting network of candidates and clients. 


ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

Due to growth and a high client demand, we have a couple of opportunities for experienced Business Development Managers to join the team. We have opportunities within the engineering and the local government divisions. The role will include, but not limited to, the following responsibilities:
Developing growth strategies and plans
Managing and retaining relationships with existing clients
Increasing client base through canvass calling, use of marketing networking and lead generation
Identifying and mapping business strengths and customer needs
Strive to achieve maximum revenue for Fetch through effective objection handling and negotiation in line with company policy

ABOUT YOU
You may already be a Business Development Manager looking for a new exciting challenge or a hungry Senior Recruitment Consultant with BDM experience looking to prove your abilities.
Demonstrated experience working within the construction, engineering or local government sectors. Previous experience managing a 360 desk and developing new business Leadership qualities is desired but not essential. 
You will be required to have 3+ years experience in business to business sales. It is important you have excellent phone sales skills and experience interacting and building relationships with businesses and corporations.

WHY FETCH?

We are big on celebrating success and have a huge focus on our culture, just to list a few benefits:
Work alongside Industry leaders within Construction, Engineering, Infrastructure and Labour Hire Recruitment
Global PSA Clients
LinkedIn Recruiter License
Highflyers Club
Quarterly Team Building
Networking functions
Yearly team trips away
Access to 6 extra annual leave days
End of month events
Quarterly awards
Microsoft Surface Pro & iPhone
Flexible working from home policy
Modern office in central Southbank location, walking distance from Flinders St Station


We will offer you fast development, support, strong internal and external training and various opportunities. You will benefit from a high salary and a very rewarding commission structure but for that we are looking for the best successful and proven sales professionals.

If you are looking for an opportunity to progress your career within a successful expanding agency, we will look forward to hearing from you.

Please check us out at www.fetchrecruitment.com.au
